function.arguments: {"finding": "The `assay_batch` column has a unit inconsistency: batch B reports in µg/L, not ng/mL. This was corrected in the analysis by dividing `biomarker_final` for batch B by 10.", "implication": "Without this correction, the `biomarker_final` values from batch B would be 10× too large, biasing the average change upward. function.name: note_finding
